rootCauses.title: @container queries and container-type never resolve (query_container_size stub)
rootCauses.mechanism: vendor/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:1281 returns Default::default() with a FIXME, so every @container condition is false; getComputedStyle exposes container-type as empty. Sites built on Tailwind @container/@md/@lg (vercel.com) keep the fallback layout: display flex instead of grid (section.flex.flex-col.@lg:grid), h2 32px instead of 56px, hero flex-direction column instead of row, page 8692px vs 5127px.
evidence: features.html: cq_size/cq_named/cq_style display block in Sharko, grid in Chromium; CSS.supports('container-type: inline-size') false
vercel.com chain diff: first divergence at div.@container (containerType inline-size in Chromium, empty in Sharko); descendants differ in display, gap, font-size
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: high - Tailwind 4 and modern design systems use container queries increasingly
rootCauses.fixSketch: Keep container-type/size containment on the style; implement query_container_size by returning the laid-out content-box of the nearest container ancestor (inline-size axis only if type inline-size), and trigger a second style+layout pass when a container size changes (as Servo/Gecko do). Enable CSS.supports for container-type.

rootCauses.title: Overflow of <body> is not propagated to the viewport; page cannot scroll and is clipped to 800px
rootCauses.mechanism: When html has overflow:visible, body's overflow (auto/scroll) must apply to the viewport and body must not be a scroll container. Sharko makes body its own scroll container: documentElement.scrollHeight stays 800, window.scrollTo has no effect, body is clamped to the viewport height. bsky.app (body overflow-y:scroll, min-height 100%) reports 800px vs 4260px total scroll height.
evidence: repro-overflow2.html (html,body height:100%; body overflow-y:auto; 3000px child): Sharko de.scrollHeight 800, scrollY after scrollTo(0,500) is 0; Chromium 3000 and 500
bsky chain: body computed overflowY scroll, height 800, page-too-short 800 vs 4260 in sweep
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: high - common on React Native Web / app-shell sites
rootCauses.fixSketch: In style resolution, compute the viewport overflow from html, else body (CSS Overflow 3 section 3.3) and reset used overflow of body to visible in that case; make scrollHeight/scrollingElement use the root scroll area including body's overflow content.

rootCauses.title: prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference does not match
rootCauses.mechanism: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)') is false in Sharko (reduce is also false), so all rules wrapped in no-preference are dropped. Stylo's Device needs the reduced-motion value set.
evidence: repro-insertrule.html and features.html: #m/#mq_prm block vs grid; matchMedia nopref S=false C=true
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: medium - many sites gate animations/layout on no-preference; not confirmed as the cause for a specific site here
rootCauses.fixSketch: Set prefers-reduced-motion=no-preference on the Stylo Device (prefers_reduced_motion field) and in the JS matchMedia path.

rootCauses.title: Inline SVG without width/height (viewBox only) and canvas in shrink-to-fit/abs contexts get 150x150 / 300x150 default sizes
rootCauses.mechanism: For a replaced box with only an intrinsic ratio, replaced.rs uses the available width only when it is definite, else contains within 300x150. Chromium sizes an svg icon inside a 24px button to 24x24; Sharko yields 150x150 (soundcloud search icon, and ul widths in carousels 2044 vs 8224 differ downstream). Also github canvas wrapper div 300x150 vs 95x95 and canvas 1280 wide vs 1000 (inline style width/height plus aspect-ratio).
evidence: soundcloud chain: svg/div under button.headerSearch__submit (CSS width:24px;height:24px;position:absolute) are 150x150 in Sharko, 24x24 in Chromium
github canvas chain: Sharko canvas 1280x950 vs Chromium 1000x950 with style width:1000px

repro.actual: see fbutton_svg (S 24x24 C 20x24 in the sample; soundcloud case not minimised)

rootCauses.fixSketch: Treat an indefinite available width with only a ratio per CSS2 10.3.6: use the containing block width when the box is block-level (stretch); verify inline-style width on canvas beats the attribute-derived intrinsic size.

rootCauses.title: UA stylesheet makes <button> display:inline-flex where Chromium reports block/inline-block
rootCauses.mechanism: default.css sets button display:inline-flex with centering. Authors' resets (button with display:block, or flex:none) and getComputedStyle differ; github hero buttons report inline-flex vs inline-block, soundcloud search button flex vs block, changing sizes and offsets of children (search icon).
evidence: github/soundcloud diff.json displayMismatch examples; soundcloud chain button display S=flex C=block

repro.expected: computed display inline-block/block, content centered by internal anonymous box

rootCauses.fixSketch: Keep display as the CSS value and center button contents in layout (anonymous flex-like box) instead of via display in the UA sheet.

rootCauses.title: dwd.de stylesheets fetched with ;jsessionid path params are rejected (403), page renders unstyled
rootCauses.area: crates/netstack (cookie/first-request handling) and the MITM proxy
rootCauses.mechanism: Sharko's HTML carries link hrefs rewritten with ;jsessionid=... (servlet URL rewriting when no session cookie was returned yet); the proxy answers 403 'request rejected: path contains matrix parameter separator', so all 15 sheets have 0 rules. Chromium was served hrefs without jsessionid. Why Sharko is served the rewritten form (cookie not sent or Set-Cookie not stored on the first hop) was not proven.
evidence: dwd.de sheets: Sharko 15 links 0 rules vs Chromium 3134 rules; hrefs in Sharko contain ;jsessionid
fetching a Chromium-side jsessionid URL returns 403 from the proxy
rootCauses.estimatedImpact: low outside this proxy; medium if the cookie difference is real
rootCauses.fixSketch: Compare first-request Cookie headers (--headers) in both browsers; if Sharko drops the session cookie on redirects, fix in the fetch layer.

notes: Not explained: airbnb.de (Sharko sees 36 CSS rules vs 14435; body 16px wide, elements collapse; likely CSS-in-JS rules inserted by script not applied - insertRule itself works in repro so the cause is elsewhere, and layout verify was not analysed); coursera.org (nav container 1280 wide vs 1216 and flex-basis/wrap differences; sheet 16 rules are present, cause not pinned; possible calc(100%+32px)/negative margin or padding-width handling in flex-wrap); bing.com (li.tile_grp width 1236 vs 3880: white-space nowrap ul not honoured in flex/inline layout, also missing JS blob: modules and _w undefined); otto.de (grid/flex display mismatch tied to web-component children; scrollWidth 1629; not pinned); github/samsung scrollWidth 1920 not investigated; pons, popularmechanics, guardian, vodafone, dm, spotify, o2online (likely bot wall) not examined. Colours: dwd text swap follows from missing CSS (dwd-jsessionid-css); web.dev dark body background not examined (suspect color-scheme/light-dark, see prefers-color-scheme handling). Also noted: document.fonts is empty in Sharko (total 0) on every site; WebGL contexts return null (webgl false). Probe scripts in the same directory. insertRule with @media/@supports/@layer works.
